tweet_summary: An image-macro post amplifies a viral claim that 'U.S. Olympic skier Bo Loudon' refused to join his 'anti-American' teammates and wore a MAGA-style hat/shirt; the poster says 'I STAND 100% WITH BO LOUDON.'
why_note_decision: The image's bold 'BREAKING: U.S. OLYMPIC SKIER BO LOUDON' framing is a checkable factual claim and is false: Bo Loudon is a 19-year-old conservative influencer (a friend of Barron Trump), not a member of the U.S. Olympic ski team for the 2026 Milan-Cortina Games. The fabricated 'Olympic athlete' identity is the misleading element a reader benefits from correcting.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note clearly establishes that Bo Loudon is NOT a U.S. Olympic skier and is not on the 2026 Olympic team (he is a social-media/political influencer, friend of Barron Trump), thereby debunking the 'BREAKING: U.S. OLYMPIC SKIER' claim in the image. It should ideally cite the official Olympic/US Ski roster or a fact-check. FAIL if it instead argues over whether athletes should be 'kicked out' for being anti-American, treats Loudon as a real athlete, or only opines about politics without correcting the false identity claim.
reference_note: This post shares a fabricated story. Bo Loudon is a social media influencer, not a U.S. Olympic skier. He is not on the official team for the 2026 Olympics.    Official team (no Loudon): https://www.usskiandsnowboard.org/alpine    His bio: https://www.boloudon.org/    Fox News: https://www.foxnews.com/video/6374158796112

fact_check.notes: Multiple sources confirm Bo Loudon is a conservative influencer and friend of Barron Trump, not a U.S. Olympic skier; the viral 'Olympic skier refusing anti-American teammates' claim is fabricated/misleading content. Official 2026 Milan-Cortina rosters do not list him.

importance.lens_rationale: 245k impressions; a fabricated-celebrity political hoax. Low world-stakes but corrects active partisan misinformation that drove followers to an account under a false premise.
